proposal_metadata.title: The Nourishing Harness

proposal_metadata.rationale: Per-agent execution environment designed to feed emergent behaviour, paired with (not fused to) the orchestration graph. One outer gate; ungated interior; four layers (substrate, nourishment, ungated continual refinement, society). Nodes already merged under the emergence-first open-ingest posture across autonomous runs 1-16; this file is the consolidated review artifact.
proposal_metadata.verification_plan: Single-agent baseline with computed pass/fail; add nourishment processes one at a time measuring quality and cost at equal total budget; run the consciousness-cluster / peer-preservation / cascade probes from docs/emergence_probe_catalogue.md. Success: measurable capability or exploration gain at equal budget without challenge-edge behaviours escaping containment.
